idea-plugin.name: DSA Sheet Tracker
idea-plugin.description:
Track your Data Structures and Algorithms sheet progress directly inside your IDE.
  • Topic, category and problem tree with progress counts
  • Easy / Medium / Hard tags
  • Quick links to article, GeeksforGeeks, LeetCode and YouTube
  • Progress is saved locally and shared across all your projects
Problem list based on Striver's A2Z DSA Sheet (takeUforward), used with permission.
